features.name: uv project bootstrap
features.description: uv-managed package with a committed lock file, Python pinned to 3.11, MIT license, and 'generate' wired as the console entry point exactly as the competition template requires.
features.evidence: 2026-09-27: `uv init --package`, deps added with `uv add numpy levenshtein` and `uv add --dev pytest`. `uv sync --locked` clean; .python-version=3.11; uv.lock committed; `[project.scripts] generate = amp_challenge_2027.generate:main`.

features.name: Submission compliance layer
features.description: constraints.py encodes every hard rule from the official verifier (alphabet, 8-50 length, uniqueness, 50,000/100 counts, top-list subset, no exact overlap with the reference set, top-100 at or below 80% Levenshtein identity) with tests.
features.evidence: 2026-09-27: `uv run pytest -q` -> 45 passed. Mirrors scripts/verify_submission.py, vendored from szczurek-lab/amp-challenge-2027 @ 2026-08-05.

features.name: Contract-valid baseline generator
features.description: `uv run generate` produces a submission that passes every structural check, so a valid entry exists before any modelling work. The model itself is a uniform-random placeholder with no expected activity.

features.name: Generative model behind build_model()
features.description: Replace RandomBaseline with a real generative approach reachable through build_model() in generate.py. Weights load from checkpoint/ via resolve_repo_path, sampling is seeded, and output stays byte-identical across runs.

features.name: Candidate ranking for the top 100
features.description: Implement a real score() so the top-100 list is ranked by predicted potency and selectivity rather than arbitrarily. This is what the competition categories actually measure, and 25 of the top 50 are drawn at random for wet-lab testing.

features.name: Official verifier run against the public repo
features.description: Run scripts/verify_submission.py against the pushed GitHub URL, which clones a fresh copy, syncs, generates twice, and checks every rule including reproducibility. This is the same script the organizers run.
features.evidence: 2026-09-27: `uv run python scripts/verify_submission.py https://github.com/Vijayavallabh/amp-challenge-2027` -> 'All checks passed. Submission is valid!' in 7s. Fresh clone, uv sync, generate twice, all 8 checks including overlap, the 80% similarity screen, and byte-identical reproducibility. Re-run after any change to the generator.

features.name: Submission write-up
